newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Riksbank leaves repo rate at 4.10 percent.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Riksbank leaves repo rate at 4.10 percent.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, left its key seven-day repurchase rate unchanged at its regular weekly tender on Tuesday, in line with market expectations.
The rate has been unchanged since December 17.
Riksbank Governor Urban Backstrom said on Monday the central bank saw no need to change its repo rate.
"The current boost to the economy means no threat to the price stability target at present," Backstrom said.
"The conclusion is therefore that there is no need to change the repo rate," he said.
The central bank's deposit rate stands at 3.75 percent and its lending rate, 5.25 percent.
